introHtml: Stitch golf polo shirts combine performance fabrics with a tailored fit that holds up wash after wash. Unlike generic polos, Stitch’s moisture-wicking material keeps you cool on the course while providing a clean backdrop for embroidery or screen printing. Marketing directors and safety managers order Stitch polos for company golf tournaments, trade show uniforms, and employee incentive programs because the brand carries a reputation for quality that reflects well on any organization.
